prompts.a:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished opaque vertical scrolling terrain texture for a top-down airplane action game, 1024x1536 portrait. Create one image, not a contact sheet.
Primary request: a frozen river scene in the same readable hand-painted aerial anime game art style as a tropical first-stage coastline. True high-altitude top-down view, no horizon. A broad quiet deep desaturated blue-teal river runs vertically through the central 60 percent of the image; low irregular snow-covered shores occupy only the left and right edges. The river contains sparse flat small broken ice floes, clustered near banks, with generous clear dark water in the center for gameplay.
Style: polished painted mobile game environment, soft broad brush planes and restrained material detail, lightly volumetric, not photorealistic, not cartoon thick outlines. Snow has ivory lit surfaces and soft slate-blue shallow edges. Banks have low rounded rocks and sparse small frosted evergreen shrubs. Extremely low relief compared with the river width, absolutely no towering cliffs or frontal walls.
Composition: edge scenery scaled small, center visually quiet; no bridge crossing the river, no central island, no giant crystalline spikes. Banks enter and leave top/bottom at similar widths to support vertical scrolling. River water is nearly uniform broad painterly gradients, subtle currents, not repeated bright caustic patterns. Small separate irregular floes, low contrast blue-white, not dense white specks. One small grounded snow-covered research shelter on the far left bank, with a few warm windows, clearly on land, much smaller than river width.
Lighting: soft cool overcast daylight, clean pale snow against deep dark blue water. No baked fog, clouds, heavy shadows, bloom, glow, text, labels, UI, aircraft, projectiles, black frames, or transparent background. Render a complete production game background that reaches all four image edges.
